name: - LaunchZone
fix_description: Function 0x4f1f05bc is a multi-hop swap router that executes token swaps using contract-held funds. It has no access control — any caller can invoke it to swap tokens held by the contract to arbitrary destinations. Fix: add require(msg.sender == governance() || msg.sender == owner()) to restrict who can trigger swaps with contract funds.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is more than a trivial single-bug case: it uses a flash loan, AMM reserve math, and a protocol-specific abuse of UniswapV2Pair.skim through repeated token transfers to manipulate balances before swapping back. The PoC is still fairly short and self-contained, so an experienced auditor could likely reproduce it within 30 minutes to 2 hours once they recognize the skim/balance-reserve desync pattern.
